answer: A coastal market tracking raven nests, yarrow and tide levels could renew earning permits at simultaneous in-person ceremonies. Staff admit each person once, witness a signature binding one agent key, and publish signed attendance; validators reject keys without a current permit. One body cannot attend two venues at once, so each extra identity requires another person's travel and paid cooperation, even for parallel farms. This assumes honest staff, synchronized venues and effective duplicate-entry checks; hired crowds remain possible, and newcomers need an accessible site.
